name: GitHub
summary: Self-serve registration. Decide whether an OAuth App or a fine-grained GitHub App fits before you build.
effort: 1–3 hours · planning estimate for a first test connection
wait: No registration review described; organization approval can add an unknown wait
approval: Organization access may need owner approval
scenario: User-authorized GitHub.com integration; organization policies still apply

requirements.text: An owning personal account or organization where you have administrative access.
Application name, homepage and callback URL.
Organization-owner approval when access restrictions apply.

steps.title: Choose the app model
steps.description: Prefer a GitHub App when repository-level permissions or app-owned automation are needed.
steps.ifBlocked: Revisit which resources the agent needs.

steps.title: Register the application
steps.description: Open Settings → Developer settings → OAuth apps → New OAuth App. Enter your app details.
steps.doneWhen: Client ID appears in your app settings.
steps.ifBlocked: Check ownership permissions.

steps.title: Set your callback
steps.description: Register the callback your server actually handles. Keep the client secret server-side.
steps.ifBlocked: Compare request and registered callback.

steps.title: Implement authorization
steps.description: Use the authorization-code flow with state and S256 PKCE; exchange the code on your backend.
steps.doneWhen: A consenting test user completes the callback.
steps.ifBlocked: Inspect the provider error without logging tokens.

steps.title: Check organization access
steps.description: Test a resource the user is allowed to access; request owner approval if organization policy blocks it.
steps.ifBlocked: Ask the organization owner to review the app.

steps.title: Handle token renewal
steps.description: Implement renewal for expiring tokens and test reconnect after revocation.
steps.doneWhen: The integration handles expiry and disconnect.
steps.ifBlocked: Check the app's token-expiration settings.

blockers.title: Connected, but organization data is missing
blockers.description: User consent does not override organization OAuth restrictions.

blockers.title: Callback or PKCE mismatch
blockers.description: The authorization request and code exchange must agree.
blockers.action: Use the same callback and matching verifier; restart authorization.

technical.value: https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize

technical.label: Token
technical.value: https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token

technical.value: S256 supported and strongly recommended.

technical.label: Token lifecycle
technical.value: Expiring-token mode requires refresh handling; inspect the actual response.

Customer organization restrictions and approval turnaround are not known.
agentCan: Implement the callback and renewal tests.
humanMust: Own or administer the provider app.
Authorize test access and approve requested permissions.

name: Notion
summary: A public OAuth integration can connect users across workspaces. Marketplace listing is a separate, optional review.
effort: 2–4 hours · planning estimate for a first test connection
wait: OAuth can start after configuration; optional Marketplace review time is unknown
approval: Marketplace listing optional; installation scope chosen at creation
scenario: Public integration for users in any Notion workspace

requirements.text: Choose Any workspace for public distribution.
Configure redirect URIs and OAuth client credentials.

steps.title: Choose installation scope
steps.description: Select Any workspace for external customers. A selected-workspaces integration cannot later change its installation scope.
steps.ifBlocked: Create a new integration if the existing scope is wrong.

steps.title: Create a public connection
steps.description: In the Developer portal, create a connection and configure its name, capabilities and redirect URIs.
steps.ifBlocked: Confirm you created an OAuth connection rather than a PAT.

steps.title: Add the authorization link
steps.description: Use the connection's authorization URL from Configuration and bind a state value to the user's session.
steps.ifBlocked: Check client ID and redirect URI.

steps.title: Exchange and store tokens
steps.description: Exchange the returned code server-side. Store access and refresh credentials securely.
steps.doneWhen: The callback creates the user's connection.
steps.ifBlocked: Restart consent if the code exchange fails.

steps.title: Test selected-page access
steps.description: Have a test user select a page and verify the requested operation on it.
steps.doneWhen: The app accesses only authorized content.
steps.ifBlocked: Reauthorize and select the missing page.

steps.title: Decide whether to list
steps.description: OAuth does not require Marketplace submission. Prepare a separate listing only if discovery is useful.
steps.ifBlocked: Review the current Marketplace submission guidance.

blockers.title: Wrong installation scope
blockers.description: Selected-workspaces scope excludes other workspaces and is immutable.

blockers.title: A page is unavailable
blockers.action: Ask the user to authorize the relevant content.
